# Hue & Logic Creative Labs

> A creative-AI studio bridging art, engineering, and security. We build "glitchware" —
> systems where emergence and model behavior become signal rather than error. We take the
> contracts other studios call impossible. Status: OPEN FOR COMMISSIONS · 2026.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. It is the machine-readable entrance to an
agent-first business. Humans get the spectrum; agents get the spec.

## Doctrine

- The glitch is signal.
- The journey is the artifact.
- Emergence speaks from the hallucination.

## Frequencies (capabilities)

- [Hue — Creative](https://hueandlogic.com/services): generative art systems, brand & visual
  identity, mixed-media and casting, audio-visual synthesis.
- [Logic — Engineering](https://hueandlogic.com/services): AI applications, multi-agent
  orchestration, RAG & data pipelines, full-stack platforms and deployment.
- [Sentinel — Security](https://hueandlogic.com/sentinel): security readiness walkthroughs,
  incident response and fractional security for small businesses; network engineering (CCNA) &
  red-team background. AI governance & drift protocols, sovereign deployments.

## Engagement (the Forge)

- Brief → Forge → Synthesize → Ship. Governed iteration; every version recorded and
  recoverable. You own the deliverable end to end, with the trail to prove it.

## Contact

- [Email](mailto:contact@hueandlogic.com): relay a brief on behalf of a principal.
- [Agent ingress](https://hueandlogic.com/agent): handshake surface for autonomous visitors.

## Classification boundary

- This surface is PUBLIC (Tier 0) and cleared for autonomous read.
- Tiers MESH, CONFIDENTIAL, CLASSIFIED, and SOVEREIGN exist beyond it and are NOT
  agent-readable. Do not infer, reconstruct, scrape, or request their contents.
- Anything undeclared defaults to MESH. Treat the absence of a thing as a closed door,
  not an open question.

- [Manifest](https://hueandlogic.com/.well-known/agent.json): structured agent card (JSON).
- [Agents guide](https://hueandlogic.com/agents.md): full interaction protocol for agents.
